units.function: Real-filesystem integration tests for local object storage round-trip, byte-range streaming, lexical cross-Company access denial and idempotent deletion.
units.dependencyDirection: Company/namespace/file metadata and bytes enter StorageService, which creates a Company-prefixed key and delegates filesystem operations to LocalDiskStorageProvider; callers read streams through the same service guard.
units.keyDataModels: Company ID, namespace, original filename, content type, object key, SHA-256, byte range, content length and HTTP-like 403/404 errors.
units.lifecycle: Put computes metadata and persists bytes; get returns the whole stream or inclusive range; another Company is denied before read; repeated delete succeeds and a later get reports not found.
units.testAssessment: The suite exercises actual disk I/O and useful provider-neutral behavior. It does not test traversal/object-key validation, directory or file symlinks under the storage root, invalid/out-of-bounds ranges, zero-byte/large streaming uploads, digest verification on read, atomic write/rename cleanup, concurrent writes/deletes, permissions, quotas, encryption, retention/legal hold or S3 parity.
units.designRationale: Provide zero-configuration self-hosted object storage behind the same service contract used by a cloud provider.
units.companyOsProblem: Evidence and artifacts must move between managed-cloud and self-hosted profiles without weakening tenant isolation, integrity or lifecycle policy.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the provider contract, streaming ranges, tenant-prefix guard and idempotent delete semantics. Local storage must use descriptor-based no-follow containment and atomic immutable writes; every read verifies immutable version/digest policy, while S3/local providers share conformance tests for encryption, retention and consistency.
units.responsibilityConflict: A Company-prefixed mutable object and put-time hash are insufficient evidence provenance. The record must bind Work, executor, permission/data contract, collection method, immutable version and verified digest; deletion must respect retention/legal-hold authority.

units.function: Mock-based unit tests asserting that creation of a primary Issue work product and promotion of an existing work product execute their demotion/insertion or demotion/update sequences inside a database transaction.
units.dependencyDirection: Issue/work-product IDs and a primary flag enter workProductService; mocked Drizzle transaction primitives record select/update/insert call counts and return a projected row.
units.keyDataModels: Work product ID, Company/Project/Issue, type/provider, external ID/URL/status/review/health, primary flag, metadata, runtime/workspace/run references and timestamps.
units.lifecycle: Creating a primary first demotes same-Company/Issue/type rows then inserts; promoting an existing row selects it, demotes its current group and updates it, all within the callback supplied to db.transaction.
units.testAssessment: The tests catch accidental removal of the transaction wrapper and expected operation order at a coarse level. Mocks do not prove rollback, isolation or concurrency safety; they omit Company scoping, cross-Company Issue consistency, group-field mutation, database constraints, not-found/error paths, import batching, removal, source trust and actual primary uniqueness.
units.designRationale: Avoid a visible intermediate state with no or multiple selected primary work products during ordinary sequential mutations.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss needs one authoritative result/evidence projection per Work and artifact type without races or cross-tenant references.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE_ONLY. Retain the behavioral intent but replace mock call-count tests with embedded-database concurrency, rollback and tenant-invariant tests backed by schema constraints and immutable Artifact/Evidence models.
units.responsibilityConflict: Transaction invocation does not prove the selected artifact is trustworthy, immutable or created under the approved Work/data contract. createdByRunId is nullable and no accountable human, approval digest or evidence digest is asserted.

units.function: CRUD and bulk-import service for mutable Issue work-product projections, including application-level selection of one primary per Company/Issue/type group.
units.dependencyDirection: Routes/importers call a Drizzle-backed service directly; database rows are cast into shared IssueWorkProduct DTOs and returned to clients.
units.keyDataModels: IssueWorkProduct with Company/Project/Issue, execution workspace/runtime service, type/provider/external identity, mutable URL/status/review/health/summary/metadata/sourceTrust, primary flag and optional creating run.
units.lifecycle: List/get query mutable rows; create or promotion demotes the existing group in a transaction; bulk import makes the last input primary per Issue/type and inserts chunks atomically; update and remove mutate by ID.
units.testAssessment: The implementation is compact and bulk import is intentionally atomic, but dedicated tests cover only transaction call counts for two primary paths. The schema has a non-unique index rather than a partial unique primary constraint, so concurrent transactions can create multiple primaries. list/get/update/remove do not require Company scope; create accepts Company and Issue independently without a composite tenant invariant; update accepts a broad insert-row patch and can move group fields without demoting the destination group.
units.designRationale: Represent external deliverables such as pull requests as lightweight mutable projections and keep one preferred result visible per Issue/type without complicating imports.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must distinguish mutable external result projections from immutable evidence/artifact records and enforce tenant/responsibility invariants inside the application boundary.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT behind Company-scoped Artifact/Evidence and ResultProjection ports. Require TenantScope on every operation, composite ownership constraints, immutable evidence versions/digests, constrained command DTOs, database-enforced primary uniqueness or serialized selection, idempotency and explicit external-observation freshness.
units.responsibilityConflict: A mutable URL/status row with nullable createdByRunId cannot establish who produced or approved a result, which permissions/data were used, or what bytes were reviewed. Missing service-level tenant scope and cross-table Company invariants create an unacceptable responsibility-chain risk.
